boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented UAB places for studying, connecting, recreation, campus events, and student support.

cards.title: UAB Campus Green
cards.subtitle: Central campus green space
cards.notes: Use the open lawn as a meetup point or check the campus calendar for fairs, performances, and student-organization events before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus gathering lawn that hosts student activities and university events.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB describes Campus Green as an open space for the university community and lists student-facing events there, including Connect Fest.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; check the calendar and reservation rules for scheduled events.

cards.title: Performance Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hill Student Center
cards.notes: Set up for a group project, independent work, or a between-class break; the stage area may be reserved only for public events.
cards.short_summary: A Hill Student Center lounge for study, group work, breaks, and small public performances.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB says the Performance Lounge is used for studying, group projects, relaxing between classes, and small public performances.
cards.access_notes: The wooden stage is reserved for public events and is not reservable by outside groups.

cards.title: Game Room
cards.subtitle: Hill Student Center
cards.notes: Bring your ONE Card and use the staffed Game Room for an on-campus activity break; follow posted equipment and sign-in procedures.
cards.short_summary: A student-only gaming space with published daytime and evening operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB's Game Room policy states that only active UAB students may use the space and must present a ONE Card for entry.
cards.access_notes: Active UAB students only; hours and capacity limits are posted by Hill Student Center.

cards.title: Off-Campus Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hill Student Center, Suite 140
cards.notes: If you commute, use this dedicated lounge to study, eat a meal, socialize, or decompress between classes during its posted weekday hours.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated Hill Student Center lounge for off-campus students between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB states that the lounge is designed for off-campus students to study, socialize, eat meals, and lounge between classes.
cards.source_title: Off-Campus Student Lounge | UAB Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Intended for off-campus students; UAB lists Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–6 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Mervyn H. Sterne Library
cards.subtitle: 917 13th St. S.
cards.notes: Choose an open study area, a quiet third-floor seat, or a reservable room; use the HUB Desk and your ONE Card when required.
cards.short_summary: UAB's undergraduate-focused library with quiet, open, individual, and group study options.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB's catalog identifies Sterne as an undergraduate activity hub with group rooms, single carrels, open study areas, and a quiet third-floor area.
cards.access_notes: Room reservations and some study spaces require a valid UAB ONE Card; check in at the HUB Desk when applicable.

cards.entity_name: Lister Hill Library of the Health Sciences
cards.title: Lister Hill Library of the Health Sciences
cards.subtitle: 1700 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a short solo or collaborative session, then check in at the HUB Service Desk with the required UAB credentials.
cards.short_summary: A health-sciences library with reservable individual and group study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Libraries lists 19 Lister Hill study rooms for current UAB community members' collaborative or individual study sessions.
cards.access_notes: For current UAB students and community members; same-day to two-week-ahead reservations and HUB check-in apply.

cards.title: Vulcan Materials Academic Success Center
cards.subtitle: Sterne Library, second floor
cards.notes: Make an appointment or stop by to connect with academic coaching, tutoring, supplemental instruction, and major-exploration support.
cards.short_summary: A Sterne Library academic-support center for UAB undergraduates.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB describes VMASC as a student-centered, peer-led tutoring and small-group instruction center in Sterne Library Room 222.
cards.source_title: Study smarter, not harder: Strategies for a smooth exam week | UAB Reporter
cards.access_notes: Located in Sterne Library Room 222; appointment availability and services vary by program.

cards.title: Campus Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 1501 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the pool, courts, fitness areas, track, or climbing wall, and confirm eligibility and facility policies first.
cards.short_summary: A large campus recreation facility with fitness, aquatics, courts, track, and climbing facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB lists a fitness center, pool, climbing and bouldering wall, courts, studios, and other recreation amenities at the Campus Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Center | UAB University Recreation
cards.access_notes: Access and participation are governed by UAB University Recreation membership and facility policies.

cards.title: UAB Mini Park
cards.subtitle: Corner of University Blvd. and 14th St. S.
cards.notes: Use this named outdoor stop as a campus meeting point, and have a registered student organization reserve it when planning an event or table.
cards.short_summary: A named UAB outdoor space available to student organizations through campus event reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Student Affairs includes UAB Mini Park among the spaces student organizations may reserve.
cards.access_notes: Student-organization reservations require access to UAB's online reservation system and may have additional rules.

cards.title: Alys Stephens Center
cards.subtitle: UAB arts venue
cards.notes: Look at the performance calendar and student-ticket details before choosing a show; UAB has documented discounted student tickets for many presented performances.
cards.short_summary: UAB's performing-arts venue, with documented student discounts for many presented shows.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB reported that the Alys Stephens Center offers $10 student tickets to most performances it presents, subject to limited availability.
cards.source_title: UAB students: Get $10 tickets to shows at the Alys Stephens Center | UAB News
cards.access_notes: Ticket availability, pricing, and eligibility vary by performance; consult the current event listing before attending.
